business_summary.text: Ador Welding manufactures welding consumables, welding equipment and automation systems, with 5 manufacturing units and 90,000 MT/yr consumables capacity.

call_points.text: Expected annual capex is ₹30-35 crores for FY27, stepping up to ₹60-70 crores for the following two years.
Volume growth is running in the mid-teens, supported by infrastructure, power, oil & gas, and shipbuilding.
Q2 gross margin was 34.2%, down 440 bps YoY, on higher steel and raw material prices.
Demand stayed healthy across infrastructure, power, oil & gas, railways, shipbuilding, defence and heavy fabrication.
The Middle East, served through the Dubai hub, remains the primary export market; the company is exploring European markets.
Management continues to evaluate acquisition opportunities to accelerate growth in automation.
The Board declared an interim dividend of ₹7.50 per equity share.
Expected annual capex is in the region of ₹30-35 crores for FY27, primarily for welding consumables lines.
Welding capacity utilization currently stands at approximately 70%.

timeline.summary: Srinivas P. Sapalya (Sr. Vice President-Corporate Affairs) confirmed on behalf of J. B. Advani & Co. Pvt. Ltd. no encumbrance on FY2025-26 shares by promoter or concerted parties as of March 31, 2026.
Ador Welding reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹317.96 Cr and recommended a dividend of ₹23 per share.
Srinivas P. Sapalya, Sr. Vice President-Corporate Affairs of J. B. Advani & Co. Pvt. Ltd., confirms no encumbrance on Ador Welding’s shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Ador Welding Limited shared the audio recording of its Analysts/Institutional Investors Meet held on April 30, 2026, via its website.
Ador Welding held its analysts and institutional investors meet on April 30, 2026, reporting FY26 revenue of approximately ₹1,135 Cr and outlining operational realignments.
Michelle Gulu Malkani, a promoter, confirmed no encumbrance on her Ador Welding shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Pravena Krishna Mathur’s promoter pledge confirmed by Tarun Mathur on behalf, no encumbrances on shares for FY2025-26.
Priya Darshini Lambert, promoter, confirmed no encumbrance on her Ador Welding shares during FY2025-26 as per SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Reshma Ashda Lalvani, a promoter, confirmed no encumbrance on her held shares during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Ador Welding paid a ₹0.34 Cr fine on October 13, 2026, to settle a BIS Act contravention regarding unauthorized possession of welding wire-flux cored.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹344.74 Cr (+22.6% YoY), net profit ₹26.94 Cr (+7.7% YoY).
Board of Directors declared an interim dividend of Rs.7.50 per equity share, record date 30 October 2026, payable by 20 November 2026.
On October 22, 2026, Ador Welding reported a 23% YoY increase in H1FY27 revenue to ₹654 Cr and declared an interim dividend of ₹7.50 per share.
Audio recording of the Analysts/Institutional Investors Meet held on 23 October 2026 is available on the company website.
Ador Welding reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹345 Cr (+23% YoY) with an EBITDA margin and declared an interim dividend of ₹7.50 per share.
